senses.gloss: जल (I) a. (f. ला) The same as जड q.v.
जल (II) n. 1. Water, R.ii.6, iii.41; 2. a kind of perfume (ह्रीवेर); 3. the constellation called पूर्वाषाढा.
जल (I) a. (f. ला) The same as जड q.v.

जाल n. 1. A net, a snare; 2. a cob-web; 3. a coat of mail, a helmet made of wire; 4. a lattice, a window, धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वलभयः संदिग्धपारावताः Vikr.iii., K.S.vii.60; 5. a collection, an assemblage, K.S.vii.89, Sis.iv.56, Am.S.58; 6. magic; 7. illusion, deception; 8. an unblown flower.
जल-अंचल n. 1. a spring, a natural water-course; 2. moss.
जल-अंजलि m. 1. a handful of water; 2. water presented to the manes of a deceased person, e.g. कुपुत्रमासाद्य कुतो जलांजलिः. (जलांजलीं दा ‘to give up, to quit, to abandon,’ Am.S.97).
जल-अधिदैवत (I) m.n. an epithet of Varuṇa.
जल-अधिदैवत (II) n. the constellation called पुर्वाषाढा.
जल-अधिप m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
जल-अर्क m. the image of the sun reflected in water.
जल-अर्णव m. 1. the rainy season; 2. the ocean of sweet-water.
जल-अवतार m. a landing place at a river’s side.
जल-अष्ठीला f. a large square pond.
जल-आकर m. a spring, a fountain.
जल-आधार m. a pond, a lake, a reservoir.
जल-धर m. 1. a cloud, Megh.i.34; 2. the ocean.
जल-धारा f. a stream of water.
जल-आर्द्रा f. a fan wetted with water.
जल-आशय m. 1. a pond, a reservoir; 2. a fish; 3. the ocean.
जल-शय, -शयन, -शायिन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जल-आश्रय m. 1. a pond; 2. a water-house.
जल-इंद्र m. 1. an epithet of Varuṇa; 2. the ocean.
जल-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Varuṇa; 2. the ocean.
जल-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of Varuṇa; 2. the ocean.
जल-उच्छ्वास m. 1. a channel made for carrying off an excess of water; 2. overflow of a river &c.
जल-उरगा ऋ।, -ओकस् ऋ।, -ओकस म्। f. a leech.
जल-उरगा ऋ।, -ओकस् ऋ।, -ओकस म्। f. a leech.
जल-करंक m. 1. a shell; 2. cocoanut; 3. a cloud; 4. a wave; 5. a lotus.
जल-कांतार m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
जल-कूपी f. 1. a spring well; 2. a pond; 3. a whirlpool.
जल-केलि m.f. playing in water, splashing one another with water.
जल-क्रीडा f. playing in water, splashing one another with water.
जल-क्रिया f. offering libations of water to the manes of the deceased.
जल-गुल्म m. 1. a turtle; 2. a quadrangular tank; 3. a whirlpool.
जल-चारिन् m. 1. an aquatic animal; 2. fish.
जल-ज (II) m. 1. an acquatic animal; 2. a fish; 3. moss; 4. the moon.
जल-ज (III) m.n. the conch shell, दध्मौ जलजं कुमारः R.vii.63, x.60.
जल-ज˚आसन m. an epithet of Brahman (m.), वाचस्पतिरुपाचेदं प्रांजलिर्जलजासनम् K.S.ii.30.
जल-जंतु m. 1. a fish; 2. an aquatic animal.
जल-तरंग m. 1. a wave; 2. a metal cup filled with water producing harmonic waves.
जल-ताडन n. beating water (lit.); any useless occupation (fig.)
जल-द m. 1. a cloud, Megh.i.3, Ghat.3, 4, 5; 2. camphire.
जल-दर्दुर m. a kind of musical instrument.
जल-देवता f. a water-nymph, a naiad.
जल-धि m. 1. the ocean; 2. a hundred billions; 3. the number ‘four.’
जल-धि˚जा f. Lakṣmī, the goddess of wealth.
जल-निधि m. 1. the ocean; 2. the number ‘four.’
जल-निर्गम m. a drain, a water-course, a waterfall.
जल-पति m. 1. the ocean; 2. an epithet of Varuṇa.
जल-पूर m. a full stream of water.
जल-प्रदान n. offering libations of water to the manes of the deceased.
जल-प्रांत m. bank of a river.
जल-प्राय n. a country abounding with water.
जल-प्रिय m. 1. the Chātaka bird; 2. a fish.
जल-प्लावन n. a deluge, an inundation.
जल-बिल्व m. 1. a pond, a lake; 2. a tortoise; 3. a crab.
जल-मंडूक n. a kind of musical instrument, (the same as जलदर्दुर).
जल-मार्ग m. a drain, a canal.
जल-मुच् m. 1. a cloud, Megh.ii.6; 2. camphire.
जल-मूर्ति m. an epithet of Śiva.
जल-यंत्र n. 1. a machine for raising water; 2. a fountain.
जल-यंत्र˚गृह, ˚निकेतन, ˚मंदिर n. 1. a house erected in the midst of water; 2. a house supplied with artificial jets of water, Rt.i.2.
जल-यंत्र˚गृह, ˚निकेतन, ˚मंदिर n. 1. a house erected in the midst of water; 2. a house supplied with artificial jets of water, Rt.i.2.
जल-यंत्र˚गृह, ˚निकेतन, ˚मंदिर n. 1. a house erected in the midst of water; 2. a house supplied with artificial jets of water, Rt.i.2.
जल-रंकु m. a kind of gallinule.
जल-रंड, -रुंड m. 1. a whirlpool; 2. a drop of water; 3. a snake.
जल-रंड, -रुंड m. 1. a whirlpool; 2. a drop of water; 3. a snake.
जल-लता f. a wave, a billow.
जल-शय, -शयन, -शायिन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जल-शय, -शयन, -शायिन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जलेशय m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a fish.
जल-सूचि f. 1. the Gangetic porpoise; 2. a crow; 3. a leech.
जल-स्थान n. a pond, a lake, a reservoir.
जल-स्थाय m. a pond, a lake, a reservoir.
जल-ह n. a small house furnished with water jets.
जल-हास m. 1. foam; 2. cuttle-fish bone considered as the foam of the sea.

जालक n. 1. A net; 2. a multitude, a collection, समुद्धृताशेषमृणालजालकम् Rt.i.19; 3. a window; 4. a nest; 5. an unblown flower, नवजलकणैर्यूथिकाजालकानि Megh.i.26; 6. illusion; 7. a particular ornament worn in the hair, R.ix.44.
जालिक m. 1. A fisherman; 2. a fowler, a bird-catcher; 3. a spider; 4. the governor of a province; 5. a rogue, a cheat.
जालिका f. 1. A net; 2. a chain-armour; 3. a spider; 4. a leech; 5. a veil; 6. a widow; 7. iron.

जल्प् vt. 1P (pp. जल्पित; pres. जल्पति) 1. To speak inarticulately, to murmur; 2. to prattle, to chatter; 3. to speak, to speak with, to converse, जल्पंति सार्धंमन्येनं Bhartr.i.82, अविरलितकपोत्लं जल्पतोरक्रमेण Ut.i.With प्र-, to speak, to say, to call.With सम्-, to converse.
जल्प m. 1. Talk, conversation; 2. gossip; 3. debate, disputation.
जाल-अक्ष m. a loop-hole, a window.
जाल-कर्मन् n. the occupation of catching fish, fishing.
जाल-कारक m. 1. a net-maker; 2. a spider.
जालिनी f. A room ornamented with pictures.
जाल्म (I) a. (f. ल्मी) 1. Cruel, harsh; 2. rash, inconsiderate.
जाल्म (II) m. (fem. ˚ल्मी) 1. A low or degraded man, a poor man, क्षणं विश्राम्यतां जाल्म स्कंधस्ते यदि बाधति । न तथा बाधते स्कंधो यथा बाधति बाधते Ud.; 2. a miscreant, a rogue, a rascal, M.M.v.
जाल्म (I) a. (f. ल्मी) 1. Cruel, harsh; 2. rash, inconsiderate.
जाल्मक a. (f. ल्मिका) Despised, base, low.
जाल्मक a. (f. ल्मिका) Despised, base, low.
